headlines.description: — The Denver Broncos are atrocious on offense, depleted on defense and shaky on special teams. All they do is find ways to win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos beat the Seahawks 17-14 in OT on Ja'Quan McMillian's pick, Wil Lutz's 53-yarder

headlines.description: — Trying to seal a desperately needed win, Houston Texans quarterback C.J. Stroud threw an interception in the end zone and gave the Jacksonville Jaguars another chance on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fairbairn's last-second 49-yard FG gives Texans 34-31 win over Jaguars at Wembley Stadium

headlines.description: — Caleb Williams had been “itching” on the sideline while missing three straight games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caleb Williams completes first 12 passes in return after missing 3 games as Bears top Falcons 31-23

headlines.description: — The Cleveland Browns have plenty of flaws in coach Todd Monken's first season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Deshaun Watson leads drive for winning field goal and Browns rally for 13-10 victory over Ravens

headlines.description: — The Tennessee Titans went from winless to party time in a jiffy Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans use special teams plays and defense to rally past Colts 26-20 for 1st win of the season

events.name: New York Jets at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — The mantra in New England's locker room under Mike Vrabel has been to never apologize for a win. So no one was feeling bad about the Patriots improving to 2-0 in the AFC East after their victory over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drake Maye's 3 TD passes help Patriots stave off late push by Jets in 26-19 win

events.name: New Orleans Saints at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Tyler Shough and the New Orleans Saints fell behind by 10 points, went up 24 and still needed to make a stop on fourth down in the end zone to hold on. They'll take it.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tyler Shough and Saints score 34 consecutive points, hold on to beat Giants 34-27 and end skid

headlines.description: — Bryce Young hit Tommy Tremble for a touchdown and Carolina's tight end went into full Rocky Balboa mode.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryce Young throws for 2 TDs and leads Panthers to 25-14 win over injury-riddled Eagles

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — The way Aaron Rodgers sees it, the Pittsburgh Steelers took a significant step with their first road win of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers throws 2 late TD passes as Steelers storm back to beat Buccaneers 26-19 in OT

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — The Arizona Cardinals had been through a month of drama and disappointment since they opened their season with a surprising victory at SoFi Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals upset Rams 18-16 on Chad Ryland's 6th field goal as time expires

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes hadn't watched the tape of the Chiefs' game against the Los Angeles Chargers from last December — that game in which he tore ligaments in his left knee and Kansas City was eliminated from postseason contention — until just this week.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs move to 5-0 as Kenneth Walker runs for two TDs in a 22-6 win over Chargers

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Jim Kelly set the standard for every Bills quarterback, but even the Hall of Famer likely wouldn't have made the type of play Josh Allen pulled off Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen ties Jim Kelly's Bills TD pass record as Buffalo holds off Raiders 33-30

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Green Bay Packers quarterback Jordan Love didn’t bother wondering what might have been.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love, Green Bay's defense lead the way in Packers' 23-13 victory over Cowboys

headlines.description: — Brock Purdy and the offense staked San Francisco to a big lead. The defense made sure the 49ers remained undefeated.
headlines.shortLinkText: Purdy and the 49ers build a big lead and hold on to beat the Commanders 23-17
